text.content:
Floralists identify and cultivate the strange seeds grown from the spiritual energy that flows within plants.

SKILLS

MAGISEEDS · SL max 5

When you rest, you gain (SL) Magiseeds. You may hold up to 10 + (SL × 5) Magiseeds and they never spoil. Use an action and plant a Magieed in a creature or object you can see within 3 squares. At the start of your next turn, if the Magieed is still planted, it blooms into one of six effects (rolled or chosen).

BRAMBLEHEART · SL max 3

When you plant a Magieed in a creature within 3 squares of you, that creature takes (SL × 2) damage and suffers slow until the end of the scene.

GREEN THUMB · SL max 1

When you plant a Magieed, you may delay its bloom by up to one round, or quicken it to bloom at the end of this turn instead of next turn's start.

BLOOMING GROWTH · SL max 2

You may plant a Magieed in an object or location that is not a creature. Blooming becomes a static effect in that area until it is cleared.

FLOURISH · SL max 3

When you plant a Magieed, you may plant an additional (SL - 1) Magiseeds in the same action, paying no action cost and distributing them among any number of creatures or objects you can see within 3 squares.
